capabilities: expand typed shortcuts into JavaScript-generated text
define shortcuts in settings or in shareable shortcut-file notes
trigger shortcuts via a buttons panel and clickable in-note links
run shell commands and external scripts from shortcuts on desktop
autocomplete and help shortcuts for discovering available expansions
disambiguation: Not a tool for running JavaScript inside note code blocks; shortcuts are typed triggers that expand into generated text.
extras: README warns that shortcuts run JavaScript and can be malicious, and that the 'Allow external' setting for shell commands is off by default. The plugin is in open beta, and it can download an entire shortcut-file library into the vault.
intentEvidence: made with awareness of and deference to the obsidian-text-expander plugin
motivation: The author wanted to fulfill an existing need for effortless cross-system, cross-platform operability of advanced text-expansion features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type a short trigger and have it replaced with dynamically generated text, especially across desktop and mobile.

relations.evidence: This project was made with awareness of and deference to the obsidian-text-expander plugin.

summary: Text expander that replaces typed shortcuts with text generated by user-written JavaScript, defined in settings or in shared shortcut-file notes.
